reportHeader: Mental Health in Midtown (CD5) Mental Health The quality of housing (e.g., lighting and density), landscape environment (e.g., green spaces), and community service facilities all can influence residents’ mental health. Additionally, environmental risk factors such as coastal storms, flooding, heat, and other disasters contribute to the stress experienced by residents.
